newsitem.title: UK: UK wool sale sees steady competition.
newsitem.headline: UK wool sale sees steady competition.

text.p: The fifth sale of the season saw steady competition and little movement in prices, according to British Wool Marketing Board brokers.
The price indicator was unchanged at 106 pence per kg since the Bradford sale on September 4.
Sales of forward wools pushed the clearance rate for the 2.68 million kg total offering up to 90 percent.
Over 98 percent of the 962,080 kg forward wools on offer found buyers, selling at an average of 108.17 pence per kg.
The total value of wool auctioned exceeded 2.5 million stg.
